title: Software Maintenance Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Software Maintenance Engineer role at Canonical

Location: This is a remote role; we have teams in all time zones.

Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world’s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

This role involves working in a dynamic Linux-based infrastructure and applications environment, spanning all layers of the stack, including bare metal, virtualization (KVM), containerization (Docker/LXC/LXD), storage (Ceph and Linux filesystems), networking (OVS, OVN and Core networking), OpenStack, Kubernetes and the open source applications running on top of them. It will challenge you to show the breadth of your engineering skills needed to work on almost any aspect of Ubuntu and the open source applications used by large enterprise customers.

This role is an opportunity for a technologist with a passion for Linux and open source to build a career with Canonical and drive success for our customers, community and the company. If you have an affinity for open source software, great communication skills, and a passion for troubleshooting and fixing issues in technology used by millions across the world, you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

You will help with troubleshooting and driving issues to resolution with workarounds, guidance, and bug fixes to be released upstream and in Ubuntu.

Location: This is a remote role, we have teams in all time zones.

Responsibilities

  • Resolve complex customer problems related to Ubuntu, Kernel, Ceph, OpenStack, or Kubernetes and other open source software
  • Maintain a close working relationship with Canonical\'s Field, Support and product engineering teams
  • Participate in upstream communities
  • Develop bug fixes, backport patches, and work with upstream for inclusion
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Demonstrate good judgment in technical methods and techniques
  • Prioritize work and manage your time effectively against those priorities
  • Participate in team discussions to improve processes, tools, and documentation

description:
Join to apply for the Inbound Sales Representative role at Toptal

Join to apply for the Inbound Sales Representative role at Toptal

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

Our Inbound Sales Representatives connect and engage with prospective clients who originate from inbound leads. They seek new business opportunities by connecting with, and developing relationships with, potential customers and guiding prospective clients throughout the required sales stages. To excel in this position, you need to effectively communicate and collaborate with clients, ensuring they understand the value of our services and how Toptal can support their goals. Our ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, is hungry to exceed sales quotas, and strives to go above and beyond. If you are passionate about sales, innately driven, and results-oriented, this is the perfect opportunity for you to launch your sales career.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Sales Cycle Management: You will be the initial face of Toptal and supporting our clients through the required sales stages. As the first point of contact and the initial ‘face’ of Toptal for new clients, you will be responsible for moving these clients forward in the sales process, starting with regularly conducting sales calls. You will be responsible for accurately articulating the benefit of Toptal to potential clients in these calls and managing deal cycles from discovery through close.
  • Client Experience: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. You will be responsible for executing upon a customer-centric approach across all of your customer interactions during pre-defined working hours. You will build rapport with our prospective clients, which will require researching clients before outreach and staying on top of industry trends and Toptal competitors.
  • Collaboration with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team to promptly respond to high-volume inbound client inquiries. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.
  • Growth and Development: Our SMB sales team members always look to improve individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical to achieving success in this role and at Toptal.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • The ideal candidate has 1-3 years of B2B sales experience (i.e. Account Executive, Inside Sales, Outside Sales Representative, Account Representative, or related title).
  • Software or tech-related sales experience and education are a plus.
  • Be attentive to client needs. You will be required to be fully available during your working hours to take client calls.
  • You are client-centric. You will be working with prospective clients daily, uncovering and resolving clients’ issues through value-based selling.
  • Have a “will-to-win” attitude. You’re looking to not only meet but exceed your quota and are naturally competitive. We provide a base salary plus uncapped commission and want our Client Advisors to make the most out of it!
  • You’re a “learn-it-all.” We are looking for someone who is always looking to grow, strives for improvement, and constantly seeks feedback from peers/ leaders. Even as an individual contributor, you seek to share and gain knowledge from those around you.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with your team members.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts. We move quickly, so having exceptional time management skills and the ability to manage a high volume of clients is key to being successful in this role.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Our group is critical to the success of our customers, partners and Ubuntu itself.

description:
Overview

Proximity Works is where high-growth teams go when the stakes are high and excellence is non-negotiable. We are a plug-and-play, AI-native powerhouse — a global ecosystem of companies across engineering, design, AI, media, and storytelling — built to help ambitious teams scale without breaking what made them great. We operate across 25+ cities and 4 countries, shipping AI in ways that drive impact.

Our companies include:

  • Proximity Tech — Engineering Performance & Scale with our AI Innovation Units

The Role

We are looking for a full-stack content & social strategist — a high-EQ operator who can write, create, market, and scale narratives that matter. This isn't a "calendar and captions" role. This is a high-ownership, high-impact seat — strategist, researcher, storyteller, trend-sniper, and executor. You’ll work directly with leadership across product, brand, marketing, and engineering to define, shape, and grow how the Proxoverse shows up in the world. We want creative thinking, outcome-driven execution, and zero hand-holding.

  • Own and evolve Proximity's brand voice across platforms

  • Use tools like Canva, CapCut, Descript, ChatGPT, etc. to create and iterate fast

Requirements

  • Have experience writing and growing newsletters — and know how to make them stick
  • Understand what makes content work algorithmically, emotionally, and strategically
  • Can go from vibe to script fast — and iterate based on traction
  • Speak fluent Internet, but also have range and taste
  • Have a strong visual eye — even if you're not a designer, you know what looks good and what doesn't
  • Avoid corporate brand-speak — you're casual without being frivolous, and never, ever cringey
  • Are genuinely curious about AI, tech, media, and sports — and can explain things simply
  • Have a strong BS-radar and low tolerance for filler — you get to the point
  • Are excited by the idea of owning a brand's digital voice from scratch

Tools You Should Know (or learn fast):

  • Canva
  • CapCut / Descript / Edits
  • ChatGPT / Claude / other AI tools
  • Notion / Google Docs
  • LinkedIn / Instagram / YouTube Shorts / Twitter (X) / TikTok
  • Email marketing platforms (e.g. Mailchimp, Beehiiv, ConvertKit, Substack, HubSpot)
  • Bonus: Figma, Webflow, Buffer, SocialPilot

Non-Negotiables

We\'ve hired great. We\'ve hired wrong. We know the difference.

  • This role is not for someone who needs step-by-step instructions
  • Cannot tolerate “good enough”
  • Creates content that looks fine but performs poorly
  • Cannot explain what made something "work" or not
  • Treats writing as a separate task, not a core part of creating content that performs
  • Requires constant hand-holding or multiple rounds of feedback
  • Thinks aesthetic equals impact
  • Is unaware or uninterested in the AI shift reshaping media, tech, and business
  • Waits to be taught instead of self-learning
  • Takes too long to ramp up without addressing gaps
  • Cannot connect content to business or bottom-line outcomes

This role is for someone who

  • Writes fast, smart, and clearly
  • Understands that content = performance
  • Can edit their own work with no typos or excuses
  • Is obsessed with how content fuels brand, growth, and business
  • Takes feedback seriously and improves quickly
  • Thinks creatively and critically
  • Has a point of view, but can adapt for different voices
  • Is strategic and scrappy — idea to asset, all in one brain
  • Thinks like a marketer, acts like a creator, and executes like an operator

Bonus Points If You

  • Are a creator yourself (personal brand, newsletter, reels, threads, Twitter, YouTube)
  • Have worked in a startup and loved wearing many hats
  • Have marketing intuition — and can connect content to conversion
  • Have a track record of building communities or audiences
  • Have motion/video chops (even light ones)

Benefits

What You'll Get:

  • 100% remote flexibility (global, async, outcome-driven)
  • A high-trust, high-performance team
  • Core working hours in PST
  • Best-in-class compensation
  • The chance to shape the voice of a fast-growing company at the edge of AI, tech, and media

title: Security Risk Management Specialist
description:
Overview

In security risk management we're looking to harness the power of industry best practice combined with driving new innovation on how we do security risk assessments and modelling. Our security risk management team is the primary owner of the strategy and practices of how we identify, track and reduce our security risk across everything we do. To support this we need to use industry best practices paired with emerging threat information to promote risk identification, quantification, impact analysis, and modelling to ultimately drive decision making. In this role, you will help establish and execute a broad strategic vision for the security risk program at Canonical. You will not only work within the team but also cross-functionally with various teams across the organisation. The team contributes ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attacks. Additionally, the team collaborates with our Organisational Learning and Development team to develop playbooks and facilitate security training across Canonical.

The security risk management team's mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.

What you will do in this role

  • Define Canonical's security risk management standards and playbooks
  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security risk practices
  • Evaluate, select and implement new security requirements, tools and practices
  • Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical security risk management practice
  • Develop Canonical security risk learning and development materials
  • Work with Security leadership to present information and influence change
  • Participate in developing key risk indicators, provide inputs to the development of key control indicators, and key performance indicators for various programs
  • Apply statistical models to risk frameworks (such as FAIR, sensitivity analysis, and others)
  • Participate in risk management, decision-making, and collaborative discussions
  • Lead quantified risk assessments and understand the value of qualitative data for improvements to quality and engineering processes
  • Interpret internal or external cyber security risk analyses in business terms and recommend a responsible course of action
  • Develop templates and materials to help with self-service risk management actions
  • Monitor and identify opportunities to improve the effectiveness of risk management processes
  • Launch campaigns to perform security assessments and help mitigate security risks across the company
  • Build evaluation methods and performance indicators to measure efficiency of security functions and capabilities.

What we are looking for

  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security
  • Leadership and management ability
  • Excellent business English writing and presentation skills
  • Problem-solver with excellent communication skills, a deep technical understanding of security assessments and risk management
  • Expertise in threat modelling and risk management frameworks
  • Broad knowledge of how to operationalize the management of security risk
  • Experience in Secure Development Lifecycle and Security by Design methodology

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Product Operations Specialist
description:
Overview

Based in Washington, DC, Quorum is a fast-growing software company and is the leading provider of workflow software and information services for government affairs professionals across the corporations, non-profits, associations, and governmental end-markets. Quorum allows users to manage stakeholder engagement, launch grassroots advocacy campaigns, and track legislative activity at all levels of government, including federal, state and local.

Quorum provides mission-critical solutions to public affairs professionals for their work in Congress, all 50 state legislatures, major U.S. cities, the European Union, and 30+ countries around the globe. Quorum serves over 2,000 customers globally including over 50% of the Fortune 100, and has over 350 team members across the globe. The company recently acquired Capitol Canary, a market leader in grassroots advocacy software.

What You’ll Do

  • First Week: You will work closely with an onboarding mentor to learn about Quorum’s many products, users, and the public affairs world. You will start getting up to speed on the operations of the Product team, our business strategies, and our complete development function.
  • First Month: You’ll get up to speed on existing product operations and start to identify and share opportunities for improvements to processes around product feedback and documentation.
  • First Six Months: You’ll have developed an improved product feedback cycle; streamlining the complete process of collecting and organizing user feedback, analyzing data to estimate and measure impact, align feedback to roadmaps across the full product portfolio, and effectively communicate updates to internal and external stakeholders.
  • First year: You’ll have made significant updates to the standard operating procedures and operations of the Product Team in order to meet the organization’s broader business objectives.

About You

  • You have at least three years of full-time professional experience working as a product operations specialist or product manager, preferably building software as a service (saas) or other B2B solutions.
  • You can demonstrate expertise in project management, from planning and execution to monitoring and completion. You can effectively manage timelines, resources, and deliverables.
  • You pay close attention to detail, ensuring accuracy in documentation, reporting, and project management. You recognize the importance of precision in product operations.
  • You are results oriented; focused on achieving measurable results and outcomes. You set clear goals and work diligently to accomplish objectives within established timelines.
  • You have exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills and can effectively present written and verbal information to a wide range of audiences.
  • You have a solid understanding of the technical aspects of product development. You communicate effectively with technical teams and grasp the intricacies of product features.
  • You’re a highly-motivated and meticulous self-starter who wants to make valuable contributions to a team from day one. You’re excited about taking initiative and getting your hands dirty to expand your skills and suggesting solutions to challenging problems that require tradeoffs.

About the Product Team

  • We’re a fast-growing team that is dedicated to improving our people, processes, and platform and putting our users first.
  • The product team includes product management, project operations, user experience, design, and user research. Product works to understand customer and market needs and to design and deliver world-class solutions that meet those needs.
  • We’re very close as a team and invest not only in each others’ skills and careers but also in building real relationships with one another: product development is a team sport and we believe that it’s better (and more fun) to work on a team of people that you know well and care about.

We are a remote-first team with flexible work options: work remotely, or you may choose to come into our office in Belo Horizonte.

Our team loves to spend time doing fun things outside of the office - both together and remote, which we call Quorum Fun events. Past Quorum Fun events have included apple picking, yoga, virtual art classes and wine tasting.

  • Standard Brazil holidays plus additional company-wide days off for team members to rest and recharge
  • Free Subscription to the Calm App
  • Free Subscription to Linkedin Learning to support professional development
  • Invest in Yourself Days - one designated day per quarter is dedicated to your professional development!
  • Monthly Work from Home Stipend
  • Virtual and in-person team events
  • Mental Health stipend
  • In company English classes
  • Inclusion & Diversity Affinity Groups to support belonging
  • 12 weeks of paid parental leave

DESCRIÇÃO:

A Valsoft Corporation está procurando um especialista em recursos humanos experiente para se juntar à nossa equipe global de RH no Brasil!

SOBRE A VALSOFT CORP.:

Fundada no Canadá em 2015, a Valsoft cresceu e hoje possui um portfólio global de mais de 120 empresas, adquirindo e desenvolvendo empresas de software de mercado vertical, permitindo que cada negócio ofereça as melhores soluções essenciais para os clientes em seus respectivos setores. Um princípio fundamental da filosofia da Valsoft é investir em negócios bem estabelecidos e promover um ambiente empreendedor que transforme as empresas em líderes em seus setores. A Valsoft busca comprar, manter e criar valor por meio de parcerias de longo prazo com a administração existente.

ABORDAGEM DE INVESTIMENTO:

Ao contrário das empresas de private equity e capital de risco, somos empreendedores que compram, aprimoram e fazem crescer negócios de software. É isso mesmo: não vendemos negócios. Formamos uma aliança estratégica com as equipes de gestão existentes. Reconhecemos a dedicação e a perseverança necessárias para criar uma empresa e valorizamos o bem-estar dos clientes e dos funcionários acima das metas de curto prazo.

CULTURA:

A Valsoft é mais do que apenas um local de trabalho; somos uma equipe. Quando dizemos que as pessoas são nosso maior patrimônio, estamos falando sério, por isso investir nelas é nossa prioridade número um. Criamos um ambiente onde nossos funcionários sentem a emoção do primeiro dia de trabalho, dia após dia, criando uma cultura de alto desempenho e colaboração. Comemoramos nossos marcos e temos orgulho deles. Sonhamos grande, permanecemos humildes e mantemos a ambição.

DESCRIÇÃO DO CARGO:

Você se juntará a um grupo de empresas com presença global em RH nos Estados Unidos, Canadá, Reino Unido e Europa, atualmente composto por 25 empresas e cuidando de mais de 650 funcionários. A equipe é composta por um diretor de RH, sediado no Reino Unido, ao qual você se reportará diretamente, com dois profissionais de RH no Canadá, um consultor de RH na Irlanda e um especialista em sistemas de RH no Canadá. Fazemos parte de uma organização maior, com sede no Canadá, e, como tal, teremos a oportunidade de aproveitar outros recursos de RH de diferentes grupos/portfólios ao redor do mundo.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Gerenciar casos de relações com funcionários de primeiro nível, incluindo resolução de disputas, medidas disciplinares, reclamações, ausências, aposentadorias; quaisquer questões complexas serão encaminhadas aos membros seniores da equipe.
  • Aplicar conhecimentos de RH e negócios, demonstrando habilidades adequadas de tomada de decisão.
  • Aconselhar os gerentes sobre os termos e condições de emprego e compartilhar as melhores práticas de conhecimento.
  • Fornecer aconselhamento de primeira linha sobre questões de emprego para funcionários e gerentes.
  • Manter contato com as equipes de folha de pagamento e comunicar as mudanças aos funcionários de forma eficaz e eficiente.
  • Realizar integrações de novos funcionários.
  • Participar da implementação de projetos, procedimentos e diretrizes específicos para ajudar a alinhar a força de trabalho com os objetivos estratégicos da organização.
  • Apoiar os processos de gestão de mudanças.
  • Isto é ideal para uma pessoa que procura crescer na sua carreira com a oportunidade de assumir uma função de gestão de RH.

REQUISITOS MÍNIMOS:

  • Licenciatura em Gestão de Recursos Humanos ou área semelhante é altamente desejável.
  • Mais de 2 anos de experiência na área de RH, seja em função generalista ou especializada, é essencial.

  • Proatividade, capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e como membro ativo de equipes de negócios e de RH.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal em português e inglês.

Remote - Full Time - Worldwide

Who We Are: Join the M.Hudson Design Team

At M.Hudson Design, we are a dynamic, employee-focused company with 25 years of professional design experience. Built on the foundation of trust and open communication, we value our team above all. Our work environment integrates remote opportunities, allowing our employees to achieve a balanced and flexible work-life dynamic.

Our Core Values guide every decision we make and shape our culture: communication, empathy, discipline, greatness, collaboration, right, simplicity, and kindness. We strive to provide a world-class client experience before, during, and after the design process, ensuring both clients and employees feel valued and supported.

If you are passionate about landscape architecture and want to grow professionally, please read the posting carefully and follow the application instructions. Attention to detail is essential in our company.

We look forward to hearing from you!

What We Do at M.Hudson Design

We specialize in crafting landscape architecture experiences for high-end residential projects in South Florida, including multi-acre estate homes, waterfront estates, country club communities, and other upscale residences. Our services cover:

  • Landscape planting plans and detailed hardscape plans (driveways, pools, pool decks, patios, walkways, retaining walls, decks, docks, fencing, and gates)
  • Design of structural elements (columns, railings) to ensure functionality and aesthetics
  • Advanced irrigation, lighting, and drainage plans
  • 3D photo-realistic models, still images, and flythrough graphics

Sample plan sets are available to view by request as part of the application process. We are committed to delivering exceptional designs and are seeking passionate individuals to join our team.

Proprietary Design Process

We have developed a comprehensive residential design process supported by LiDAR site inventories and advanced drafting and graphics software. Our workflow emphasizes clear communication and alignment with clients throughout the project. Applicants may request a copy of our detailed design and drafting process outline as part of the application (restricted to applicants).

Our process helps us deliver projects on schedule while maintaining high standards and client satisfaction.

Job Description

As a Landscape Architecture Junior Drafting Professional, you will support the pre-design and preliminary design phases. In close collaboration with the Senior Drafting Professional and the design team, you will develop precise technical drawings and plans to establish a strong foundation for projects. Attention to detail and teamwork are essential to meet our high standards and vision.

This position offers the potential for performance bonuses based on team success. Details will be provided during the interview process. There is room for growth within the company, including promotion to Senior Drafting Professional to manage a drafting team and larger projects.

This role is hired as a freelance contractor, offering flexibility within a supportive, collaborative environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Developing pre-design deliverables, including the Survey Base Sheet, Inventory Base Sheet, Proposed Base Sheet, and Inventory Proposed Base Sheet to support project initialization.
  • Drafting schematic designs in collaboration with the design team using AutoCAD, Photoshop, and Illustrator.
  • Drafting preliminary designs while ensuring feasibility, aesthetics, and alignment with client vision.
  • Ensuring accuracy and compliance with local codes and regulations as directed by the design team.
  • Collaborating with team members to refine designs and advance project goals.
  • Updating drafts based on feedback and revisions to align with project standards.

This role offers growth opportunities within a dynamic team working on high-end residential projects.

Required

Qualifications & Skills:

  • Proficiency in AutoCAD; familiarity with Photoshop and Illustrator is a plus.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Foundational understanding of landscape architecture principles, especially for residential design.
  • Self-sufficiency and ability to manage deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred

  • Educational background in Landscape Architecture (undergraduate or graduate).
  • Experience in residential landscape architecture, particularly high-end or luxury projects.
  • Familiarity with Florida planting materials and regional considerations.

Experience Requirements

  • 1-3 years of experience drafting landscape plans in AutoCAD.

Work Environment

Remote work from a home office with a collaborative, communicative culture. We use Google Chat, email, and weekly Google Meet meetings to stay connected and aligned on goals.

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation is competitive with growth opportunities and performance-based incentives:

  • Hourly rate: $15-$25/hr based on experience
  • Minimum 3% annual inflation-based increase
  • Annual performance-based hourly increases
  • Annual performance bonus

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
Mission

Our mission is to SAVE AND IMPROVE LIVES BY EMPOWERING HEALTHCARE CONSUMERS. Come be part of remarkable.

Overview

How you can make a difference

The Product Marketing Manager is responsible for making sure both internal and external audiences fully understand what our products are, how they are used and what value and return on investment (ROI) they provide. This role is the glue that binds our product strategy to the tactics we need to drive success in sales and marketing and to achieve results. This role is the product evangelist and will play an integral role in organizing product launches. This role knows our competitors: what they do today and what they plan to do in the future. The Product Marketing Manager knows our buyers better than they know themselves, including how they make their buying decisions. This role backs up strategic insights with market evidence and then uses that knowledge to drive the development of positioning and messaging that resonates with the market and empowers our marketing team and sales channels to be successful. This role typically reports to the AVP, Product Marketing.

What you’ll be doing

Product Go-to-Market Strategy, launches and business line goals

  • Foster strong relationships and communicate proactively with Product GM’s, Product Managers, Product Owners and Business Analysts to inform, create and activate product roadmaps for your product suite.
  • Develop, lead, and manage go-to-market strategy and drive launch plans for unique product initiatives to ensure that all requirements are met in a timely way.
  • Manage ongoing prioritization and completion of multiple GTM initiatives simultaneously.
  • Work cross-functionally with program and product managers to inform launch plans and enablement activities.
  • Support the creation of a variety of assets (narratives, experience decks, product definition documents, customer presentation decks, feature guides, and educational materials) associated with the GTM plan.
  • Collaborate with GTM Enablement Manager(s) and Sales Enablement team to deliver enablement effectively and in a timely, efficient manner.
  • Engage with Sales and Relationship management to assure cascade of product knowledge and gathering of customer feedback.
  • Participate in definition and measurement of GTM metrics with Product, Sales and Marketing partners.

Product messaging (Storytelling)

  • Responsible for developing positioning, messaging, and competitive differentiation for your assigned product suite and initiatives.
  • Ability to translate product features into benefits that stick with customers and attract prospects.
  • Identify and incorporate indicators and data that substantiate reasons to believe in our products.
  • Create positioning and message briefs that drive content and marketing asset development.
  • Collaborate with content teams to ensure that marketing collateral and decks have appropriate, optimized, differentiating messaging regarding our products.
  • Define the product consumer (client, members, partners, brokers, etc.) persona and customer journey for your products and initiatives.
  • Stay up to date by conducting and/or participating in voice of the customer (VoC) interviews, focus groups, surveys, and other research to convert feedback into actionable insights that can be shared with Product Management, Marketing, various relationship manager groups.
  • Assist as a client-facing subject matter expert (as needed) along-side product and sales engineering for your assigned product suite.

Market and competitive intelligence

  • Working collaboratively with Market Research, understand the competitive landscape and stay up to date on how competitors are positioning the products.
  • Provide competitive analysis that informs resources for external-facing groups, and appropriately positions HQY products to help sales win deals.
  • Stay up to date and share competitive intel, trends, member personas and voice of customer (VoC) not only with external facing groups, but also product management to help drive feature development and adoption.

Ongoing Amplification

  • Work with Director of Product Marketing to determine and track product marketing pipeline.
  • Maintain GTM resources that gather, synthesize, and present summary of all product launches related to your product suite on an ongoing basis to expanded audiences (e.g., GTM Hub, Marketing stand ups, What’s New)
  • Review and update Sales collateral, Product roadmaps and other documents.
  • Work with Communications to provide thought leadership ideas and themes related to assigned products
  • Work with Sales & RM training counterparts to regularly inform enablement trainings regarding our products, and how we solve buyer and user challenges

What you will need to be successful

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field
  • Knowledge of product marketing or a closely related field
  • Manage, create and execute go to market strategy and plans as described as normally obtained through a minimum 5 years’ experience in a product marketing role with 2 years’ specific experience in a market-facing role (delivering presentation to customers and prospects, conducting competitor analysis and market research)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong project and time management skills
  • Demonstrable product marketing success in the financial services, card issuer, benefits administration, healthcare payments or a related industry
  • Understand marketing principals and experience with practical application of these principals
  • Positioning and messaging
  • Strategic and tactical planning
  • Leadership, collaboration and influence
  • Product development methods (agile)
  • Research and analysis
  • Storytelling through effective writing and presenting
  • An attention to detail and eye for quality are critical to success, along with an ability to grasp and present our product's value proposition in a way that resonates and clearly articulates how we solve our buyers' problems.
  • Ability to track performance and have the data to prove what's working and what isn’t
  • A strong customer service orientation is essential
  • Demonstrated ability to adapt to the changing demands of business is a must
  • Proficiency with business and communications software (preferably Word, Excel, PowerPoint, common Windows operating systems, and Outlook) is required
  • Comfortable using collaboration tools such as Teams, Smartsheet, etc. ROI-tracking skills, able to prove what is or isn't working

Candidates should be technically skilled and familiar with embedded Linux and RTOS. We are continuously expanding our offerings to enhance security, management, and developer experience across small Linux environments and devices. We have added real-time Linux capabilities and are working towards certifications to ensure reliability and security.

Our goal is to offer more solutions than any other vendor, enabling deployment across all clouds, compute types, and applications. Canonical provides licensed enterprise software, support, managed services, consulting, and training for Ubuntu and open source applications in cloud, data center, and IoT ecosystems. We are experiencing steady growth and operate in a mostly remote environment with leadership across many countries. We believe talent is globally distributed and aim to build a diverse team of exceptional leaders.

Our hiring process is rigorous, taking three to six months, and is suited for ambitious, long-term career-oriented candidates. We seek individuals with high ability and character, committed to teamwork, diligence, and excellence. We value five qualities in our sales team:

  • Empathy for customers
  • High intellect
  • Passion for technology
  • Teamwork
  • Energy

While Ubuntu’s wide adoption provides a strong market foundation, success requires proactive relationship-building and territory development.   • Collaborating with marketing to promote our brand
  • Developing pipeline via outreach and industry events
  • Closing contracts to meet/exceed targets
  • Managing customer relationships
  • Working with IoT Field Engineers
  • Maintaining accurate sales data
  • Building relationships with key decision-makers

  • Strong academic background
  • Technical degree (preferably in engineering or related fields)
  • Confidence in communication and feedback exchange
  • Proven sales achievement in embedded Linux or enterprise software
  • Experience with Linux (Debian/Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal and presentation skills
  • Willingness to travel up to 50%, including international travel
  • Ability to develop sales strategies and execute plans

What we offer:

  • Distributed work environment with biannual in-person team sprints
  • Learning and development budget of USD 2,000/year
  • Annual performance reviews and rewards
  • Comprehensive benefits, including parental leave and wellness programs

Job description

Direct Response Copywriter — Pure is looking for a Direct Response Copywriter to join our team. You will be responsible for ideation, scripting, planning, and managing the entire creative process with a focus on UGC ads and psychology-based creatives used across paid marketing channels.

We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience in creating paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, UGC, direct response marketing and bonus points if experience with influencer / UGC partnerships.

Who are we?

At Pure, we are dedicated to transforming lives by creating high-quality supplements backed by science and trusted by our growing community. Our mission is to make achieving better health simpler, more effective, and more accessible for everyone. Since our launch, we’ve scaled rapidly through viral digital marketing and built a passionate customer base that loves and trusts our products. We operate with a small but mighty team that thrives on innovation, data-driven growth, and relentless creativity—and we’re excited to bring on a Creative Strategist to play a pivotal role in scaling our brand even further.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values: "work smart", "overdeliver", "speed is king" and "better everyday". We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders and play a huge role in scaling it to $12M+ a year. Drive results with a group of passionate, smart & hardworking fun people. Work in an environment without politics, or corporate chicanery. Play a big part in our growth being hands on, active, and doing what is necessary with an excellent bonus plan based on performance then you have come to the right place.

Key Objectives

  • Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis.
  • Work with our content manager to find, manage and source new content to be used across all marketing channels
  • Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives.
  • Script UGC Direct response creatives
  • Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives.
  • Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas.
  • Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
  • Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative

Requirements

  • Fully remote
  • Fluent in English
  • Direct Response Expertise : 3+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must.
  • Tools & Metrics : Proficiency in performance analytics tools such as Triple Whale, Motion, pitch decks, and spreadsheets to present ideas and campaign outcomes effectively.
  • UGC Experience : Lots of experience with creating briefs for UGC creators to produce high converting content across paid channels.
  • Creative & Analytical Mindset : Ability to generate fresh ideas, write scripts, shot listing, and make data-driven decisions based on ad performance.
  • No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn’t know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work.
  • Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
  • Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
  • Basic psychology-based copywriting skills

Aqui na Zappts, Sawabona traduz e representa o que mais prezamos em nossas relações: o respeito e a valorização do outro.

Who are we?

At Pure, we are dedicated to transforming lives by creating high-quality supplements backed by science and trusted by our growing community.   • Manage the full creative process (from scripting to final creative) to produce high-converting creatives on an ongoing basis.

  • Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve creatives for ongoing performance gains.
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to develop new creative concepts and ideas.

  • Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis.
  • Decide on next steps to scale Meta Ads through better creative.

Requirements

  • Fully remote
  • Fluent in English
  • Direct Response Expertise: 3+ years experience with performance creative for DTC brands or at a creative agency.

  • Excellent cultural fit with our values.
  • Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
  • Basic psychology-based copywriting skills

Accountabilities

  • Brainstorm and pitch weekly ad ideas aligned with direct response principles.
  • Write 80-100 high-converting ad scripts per week for Meta Platforms.

  • Present performance analyses and creative strategies to the marketing team.

When hiring, we’ll work with you to define the KPIs you’ll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around whether you’re doing a good job after you start.

Initial soft interview, then a technical interview + test project with the current head of marketing, and a final interview to ensure culture fit. We plan to hire within ~8 - 10 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.

For this specific role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business — and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed!

Salary Expectation

USD $36,000 USD to $70,000 USD per year + Performance Bonus Structure based on experience and expertise.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com testes automatizados e pipelines de integração.

description:
Descrição

Estamos à procura de um(a) Estrategista de Marketing Social Media para a nossa marca de Óculos de Sol Rosa Coral (Nosso IG: @userosacoral.br). Nessa jornada, contamos com nossos talentosos colaboradores que vestem a camisa por um propósito muito maior em busca dos objetivos da marca, tornando a história da Rosa Coral excepcional e única. Estamos em busca de uma verdadeira super estrela , que traga criatividade para se juntar ao nosso time de marketing como guardiã das redes sociais e estratégia . Nossa marca investe em diversas frentes, desde influenciadores a anúncios online, utilizando as redes sociais como nossa principal vitrine. Essa super estrela será responsável por conceituar, executar e disponibilizar ideias de conteúdo , além de redigir textos para e-mails de marketing, mensagens transacionais, landing pages e outros materiais. É essencial que seja um pioneiro em conteúdos trending, assegurando que a empresa aproveite as tendências da internet para maximizar seu impacto.

Modalidade: Home Office

Responsabilidades:

  1. Criar estratégias de marketing de conteúdo para promover a marca, produtos ou serviços em diversas plataformas de mídia social.
  2. Gerenciar e administrar contas de mídia social da empresa, como Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, entre outras.
  3. Criar e publicar conteúdo relevante e envolvente nas redes sociais regularmente, incluindo texto, imagens, vídeos e outros formatos de mídia.
  4. Monitorar e analisar métricas de desempenho nas redes sociais para avaliar o impacto das estratégias e campanhas.
  5. Responder a perguntas, comentários e mensagens dos seguidores das redes sociais, mantendo um alto nível de atendimento ao cliente.
  6. Interagir com influenciadores e parceiros para promover a marca e desenvolver parcerias estratégicas.
  7. Acompanhar as tendências e novidades nas mídias sociais e propor novas ideias e abordagens criativas para aumentar o engajamento.
  8. Realizar pesquisas de mercado para identificar o público-alvo e adaptar as estratégias de conteúdo de acordo.
  9. Colaborar com outros departamentos, como marketing, design e comunicação, para garantir a consistência da marca e a integração de campanhas em diferentes canais.
  10. Redigir textos para diversos formatos, incluindo e-mails de marketing, mensagens transacionais, landing pages, posts em redes sociais, entre outros.
  11. Manter-se atualizado sobre as melhores práticas e tendências em marketing digital e mídias sociais.

Requisitos:

  1. Experiência comprovada em gerenciamento de contas de mídia social, criação de estratégias e conteúdo.
  2. Experiência em redigir textos para diversos formatos, incluindo e-mails de marketing e páginas de vendas.
  3. Conhecimentos desejáveis em Excel, Canva, Photoshop, Meta Business, Edição de vídeo.

description:
Job description

Hello,

Você Analista de Projetos Sênior, que deseja uma oportunidade inovadora, venha atuar em uma instituição responsável por viabilizar a comercialização de energia elétrica no Brasil.

Estamos buscando um profissional hands on, com foco em desenvolvimento profissional, atualizado e apaixonado por tecnologia.

Confira os requisitos


Main responsibilities

  • Gerenciamento do portfólio de projetos de TI com atividades de monitoramento, medição de progresso e elaboração de reportes padronizados;
  • Elaboração do plano de gerenciamento do projeto, documentando as ações necessárias para definir, preparar, integrar e coordenar todos os planos auxiliares;
  • Elaboração de documentação das necessidades das partes interessadas, realizando follow-up com os especialistas do projeto (ex. analistas e arquitetos) para coleta e qualificação dos requisitos funcionais e não funcionais em suas áreas de atuação;
  • Elaboração de documentação com descrição detalhada do projeto e do produto;
  • Criação e manutenção da estrutura analítica do projeto, subdividindo as entregas e o trabalho em componentes menores de forma a facilitar o processo de gerenciamento;
  • Definição, seqüenciamento, estimativa de esforço e duração das atividades do projeto, utilizando do conhecimento e experiência dos especialistas do projeto (ex. analistas e arquitetos) em suas áreas de atuação;
  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção do cronograma do projeto;
  • Elaboração de documentação e manutenção do plano de recursos humanos do projeto, incluindo os papéis e responsabilidades, habilidades necessárias e relações hierárquicas do projeto;
  • Apoio no gerenciamento das comunicações do projeto, provendo informações gerenciais aos geradores de conteúdo e acompanhando calendários e eventos de comunicação;
  • Apoio na documentação e manutenção do plano de riscos;
  • Acompanhamento e medição da execução do projeto e identificar desvios em comparação com o plano de gerenciamento estabelecido;
  • Apoio na realização dos processos de auditoria de qualidade de forma a garantir que sejam usados os padrões de qualidade e as definições operacionais apropriadas;
  • Apoio no gerenciamento da equipe do projeto, documentando e mantendo planos e controles de alocação, programação de férias e indisponibilidade, informações de desempenho, dentre outros;
  • Apoio ao gerente de projetos na comunicação interna e monitoramento do clima organizacional, motivação e desempenho das equipes do projeto;
  • Apoio na consolidação e distribuição das informações relevantes do projeto às partes interessadas;
  • Monitoramento e controle do projeto, acompanhando, avaliando e regulando o seu progresso para atender aos objetivos de desempenho definidos no plano de gerenciamento do projeto, o que inclui a realização de medições de progresso, previsões e reportes de status;
  • Apoio na realização de reuniões de projeto, preparando materiais de suporte, controlando agendamentos e logística, documentando atas e pró-memórias, fazendo follow-up dos itens de ação e decisões, dentre outros;
  • Controle do escopo do projeto, através do monitoramento do andamento do escopo do projeto e do produto, e do gerenciamento das mudanças na linha de base do escopo;
  • Controle do cronograma, monitorando o andamento do projeto para atualização do seu progresso e gerenciamento de mudanças na linha de base do cronograma;
  • Apoio na realização do controle de qualidade monitorando e registrando os resultados das atividades de qualidade para avaliar desempenho e recomendar mudanças;
  • Reporte do desempenho do projeto, coletando e distribuindo informações sobre o desempenho, inclusive relatórios de andamento, medições de progresso e previsões;
  • Monitoramento e controle dos riscos do projeto;
  • Apoio no encerramento do projeto, ou das fases, apurando e documentando finalização de todas as atividades de todos os grupos de processos de gerenciamento para terminar formalmente a fase ou o projeto.

Desejável

A Videosoft atua em todos os processos que envolvem um projeto de sucesso. Desde a fabricação dos terminais, através da nossa fábrica própria, passando pelo desenvolvimento dos softwares/integrações e o monitoramento dos periféricos e aplicativos, até uma ampla rede de Assistências Técnicas distribuída por todo território Nacional. Com mais de 20 anos de mercado, somos uma empresa de Tecnologia, especialista em soluções para autoatendimento. Estamos localizados no Litoral Catarinense, com ótima qualidade de vida!

Oportunidade para atuação remota. (SUL/SUDESTE)

Missão da Vaga

Ser protagonista no desenvolvimento de soluções robustas, escaláveis e modernas, atuando com foco em performance, segurança e boas práticas de arquitetura. Você será responsável por construir e evoluir aplicações utilizando Angular e Node.js, integrando serviços em nuvem (AWS), APIs REST e WebSockets, além de contribuir com decisões técnicas, automações e melhorias contínuas em ambientes de CI/CD. Esperamos alguém que combine autonomia técnica com colaboração ativa, e que tenha olhar atento para qualidade de código, eficiência e inovação.

Requisitos Necessários

  • Experiência sólida com Angular
  • Conhecimento em PWA (Progressive Web Apps)
  • Boas práticas de componentização, lazy loading, e comunicação entre componentes
  • Desenvolvimento com Node.js (usando Express ou frameworks similares)
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas com REST APIs e WebSockets
  • Tratamento de autenticação e autorização (JWT, OAuth, etc.)
  • Experiência em ambientes AWS
  • Familiaridade com CI/CD usando GitHub Actions
  • Conhecimento básico de Docker
  • Experiência com MySQL e/ou PostgreSQL e MongoDB
  • Conhecimento em modelagem relacional, normalização, e otimização de queries
  • Domínio de padrões de projeto (Design Patterns) aplicados em JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Experiência com Clean Architecture e separação de responsabilidades (Domain, Application, Infra)

Será Considerado Diferencial

  • Noções de segurança web (XSS, CSRF, rate-limiting, etc.)
  • Conhecimento em React
  • Testes unitários e integração (Jest, Jasmine, etc.)
  • EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, API Gateway (desejável)
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento mobile Android (Java/Kotlin)
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban)
  • Boas práticas de documentação (Swagger/OpenAPI)

Que Tipo De Profissional Buscamos

  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma e colaborativa
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal
  • Capacidade de estimar tarefas e cumprir prazos
  • Perfil proativo na identificação de melhorias e resolução de problemas

Horário Comercial: Segunda feira à sexta feira

title: Salesforce Data Migration Specialist
description:
About Us

Kelley Austin takes a different approach to Salesforce Consulting by putting our employees first. That’s not hyperbole, either. Our team takes a proactive approach to employee satisfaction by having every single person fill out a “happiness list,” which comprises the top ten things each employee finds happiness in outside of work.

We review those happiness lists regularly to ensure everyone is checking most of the boxes and adjust their project load, responsibilities, or schedule accordingly if not.

Look at our benefits and perks below to learn more about our culture.

We’re growing fast (more than doubling YOY) but staying diligent in hiring the best possible people who don’t just want a job, but will actually care about the success of their co-workers and clients.

Our growth, coupled with the distinction of being recognized as the \'fastest Salesforce Implementation Partner to achieve Platinum / Summit status,\' attests to the success of our approach.

Take a look at the ‘About You’ and ‘Responsibilities’ below to learn more :

Benefits

  • Base Salary
  • Work From Home Flexibility
  • Flexible PTO (we treat people like adults here)
  • Paid Holidays (including an entire week off around Christmas and New Year)

Tools We Use

  • As a technology software consulting company, we use many tools, but the big four are Google Drive, Slack, Lucid Chart, and Salesforce, of course.

Perks Of The Job

  • You won’t really find egos here. We hire slowly and purposefully to keep our culture strong and our team cohesive.
  • We don’t say yes to every client and are not afraid to part ways with a client, either. If there’s no mutual respect or success involved, we politely decline and help them find a different partner. That means fewer ‘tough’ clients and more clients who “get it” and work harmoniously together.
  • We offer half a dozen different clubs like book club, health club, movie club, hobby club, and more. These bring people together to grow intellectually and get to know one another outside of project work.
  • We work an average of 40 hours per week (I know, that’s unheard of in consulting, but we stand by it).

About You

We are seeking a Data Migration Specialist with deep hands-on expertise in Salesforce, Salesforce SOQL, Salesforce APEX, relational databases, SQL, scripting, and large-scale data migration. This role is highly execution-focused and detail-oriented — you will be designing and running ETL processes, writing queries and scripts, validating data quality, and ensuring successful end-to-end migrations between enterprise systems.

Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and manage end-to-end data migration projects , including extraction, transformation, loading, and validation.
  • Write and optimize complex SQL and SOQL queries for data validation, migration, and reconciliation.
  • Build, configure, and run ETL jobs to move and transform data across Salesforce, ERP, and external databases.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts (APEX, Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar) for data processing, cleansing, and quality checks.
  • Perform data profiling, mapping, and transformation to meet business and technical requirements.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve migration issues such as data mismatches, performance bottlenecks, and integrity errors.
  • Collaborate with internal and external Salesforce, integration, and business teams to coordinate cutovers and validate migrated data.
  • Document migration procedures, scripts, mappings, and reconciliation steps for repeatability and compliance.
  • Ensure all migrations follow best practices for data quality, security, and governance .

Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent hands-on experience).
  • 5+ years of direct experience in data migration, ETL, or database engineering roles.
  • Strong technical expertise in relational databases (Salesforce, Oracle, SQL Server, or similar).
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL (query optimization, joins, stored procedures).
  • Practical experience with Salesforce SOQL, APEX, and Salesforce data model .
  • Proven track record in data migration projects , including reconciliation and cutover planning.
  • Hands-on scripting skills in Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar .
  • Familiarity with ETL tools, APIs, and bulk data processing .
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a plus.
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to deliver under tight deadlines.

NOTE: Kelley Austin will not be able to sponsor applicants for work visas.

title: Especialista em Implementação e Suporte de ON!Track
description:
O que procuramos?

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa com perfil comercial, excelente capacidade de comunicação e apresentação, que tenha facilidade para redesenhar processos operacionais dos clientes, identificar gaps e implementar melhorias usando as soluções digitais da Hilti, especialmente o ON!Track (solução digital que ajuda empresas a gerenciar ferramentas, equipamentos e ativos em tempo real). Este papel é essencial para garantir uma experiência de cliente excepcional e sustentável, atuando em parceria com os times de vendas e marketing locais e regionais.

Em que se consiste o trabalho?

Você será responsável por liderar a implementação dos nossos serviços digitais, com foco em:
  • Treinamento de clientes e melhoria de processos operacionais.
  • Compreensão profunda dos fluxos de trabalho dos clientes para aumentar a produtividade com as soluções Hilti.
  • Coordenação com os times de vendas e marketing locais e regionais para garantir colaboração e inovação.
  • Apoio ao lançamento e adoção de novas funcionalidades dos serviços.
  • Atuação prática e estratégica junto aos clientes, com visitas frequentes e engajamento direto.
  • Este papel exige mobilidade frequente em todo o Brasil,de 2 a 3 semanas por mês (de segunda a sexta-feira).

Isto é o que você precisará:

  • Formação superior completa (não é necessário curso específico).
  • Experiência comercial com foco em relacionamento com clientes.
  • Habilidades de comunicação, apresentação e engajamento.
  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e pensar de forma operacional.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes.
  • Inglês intermediário (desejável).

Por que vale a pena enviar sua candidatura?

Nossos funcionários compartilham um estilo muito próprio de ser. São determinados e dedicados, dando sempre o melhor si para exceder as expectativas dos nossos clientes. Em contrapartida, usufruem de carreiras incrivelmente dinâmicas e diversificadas. 93% dos nossos colaboradores dizem estar orgulhosos em trabalhar para a Hilti, graças à qualidade dos nossos produtos e a forma como cuidamos dos nossos colaboradores.

O que oferecemos?

  • Plano de saúde e odontológico
  • Vale alimentação/refeição
  • PPR – Plano de Participação nos Resultados
  • Totalpass (convênio com academias)
  • Seguro de Vida
  • EAP - Programa de Orientação Pessoal (Psicológica, Jurídica, Financeira e Social)
  • Niverday – 1 dia de folga no mês do seu aniversário
  • Auxílio Educacional
  • Premiação por tempo de serviço
  • Cultura de cuidado: gifts em datas especiais
  • Convênio com SESC/SENAC
  • Modelo de trabalho flexível
  • Descontos em produtos

Sobre a empresa

Com apenas quatro anos, a Predialize já é a 3ª Construtech de destaque nacional. Sonhamos com um futuro melhor para as pessoas e para o planeta. Para nós, construir o amanhã é melhorar a relação das pessoas com o lugar em que elas vivem. Criamos um novo jeito de conectar pessoas e integrar processos nas etapas pós-obra através da tecnologia. Acreditamos em uma construção civil mais sustentável e humanizada.

Sobre a vaga

Estamos em um momento de crescimento acelerado e queremos ampliar nossa capacidade de desenvolvimento para aumentar a velocidade de entrega, garantir qualidade e estabilidade nas nossas ferramentas, além de melhorar a escalabilidade e o engajamento dos nossos usuários na plataforma.

Por isso, estamos contratando duas pessoas desenvolvedoras Full Stack experientes, criativas e com habilidade para resolver problemas de forma eficiente.

IMPORTANTE : Uma das posições é voltada para quem mande bem em frontend e adora criar interfaces de alta qualidade.

Temos um time incrível e buscamos pessoas que tragam maturidade (sem perder a leveza) e energia para nos ajudar a conquistar grandes resultados! Se você quer trabalhar com um time engajado, fazer a diferença no crescimento de uma startup inovadora e acredita que tecnologia e construção civil podem caminhar juntas para transformar o mercado, vem com a gente!

Principais responsabilidades

  • Participar efetivamente de todas as etapas de um processo de desenvolvimento de software, desde a concepção das funcionalidades até a implementação, manutenção e versionamento dos projetos;
  • Codificar garantindo a qualidade do trabalho e levando em consideração aspectos relacionados à escalabilidade, performance e experiência do usuário.
  • Participar ativamente e sugerir melhorias no processo de desenvolvimento;
  • Buscar constantemente aperfeiçoamento técnico;
  • Ser constante em comprometimento com o time, entregas e a empresa.

O que esperamos de você

  • Frontend com Angular 8+, Angular Material e Scss.
  • Conhecimentos em UX / UI
  • NodeJs.
  • Javascript (vanilla)
  • Typescript.
  • Apis Rest + Express.
  • WebSocket
  • Docker.
  • Bancos de dados multitenant.
  • MongoDB (NoSql).
  • Clean Architecture + Clean Code (DDD, Inversão de Dependência, Injeção de Dependência, SOLID etc)
  • Programação Funcional
  • Programação Orientada a Objetos
  • AWS (ECS, Fargate, CloudFront, S3, Service Discover, Route 53, CloudWatch, EC2, Route Tables, ALB)

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Experiência como DevOps

O que oferecemos

title: Marketing Specialist, Nutraceuticals
description:
Job Title

Marketing Specialist, Nutraceuticals

Reporting To

Marketing Manager

Location

Remote - California based (10-25% estimated travel)

Work Schedule

Generally, M-F 8am to 5pm

FLSA Status

Full-time, Salaried Exempt

Compensation

The following information is provided in honesty as a general description of the salary range. The actual compensation offered to the successful candidate is dependent upon related factors such as, skills, experience, education, etc. Salary Range Estimate: $69,000 - $80,000 annually

Market Void

The current medicinal mushroom industry is split between low-quality producers and US cultivators with limited capabilities and product offerings. The industry is void of a low-cost, US-based producer that can offer a full medicinal mushroom product line (pure fruiting body and mycelium-based products) and that can serve as an unbiased, scientifically sound market educator and leader.

Opportunity

As the industry leader for over 50 years, Monterey Mushrooms has the production capacity, expertise, distribution network, R & D capability, and trusted brand to fill the market void and become the dominant global supplier of US-grown medicinal mushrooms.

Our Passion

We know mushrooms! From seed (spawn) to powder, we have control over every aspect of our business as we\'re a vertically integrated mushroom producer in North America. The spawn we use to grow our medicinal mushrooms is produced by our affiliate, Amycel SpawnMate. Then, we grow, dry, and package everything at our facilities in California to ensure our mushroom powders reach their full potential. If that is not enough, we third-party test for heavy metals, pesticides, mycotoxins, polysaccharides, and various compounds. In house, we test every product for potency, quality, and purity, and we have that verified by a third party periodically. Monterey Nutraceuticals is a portfolio company of Paine Schwarz Partners, who invested in the business in May 2022. For more information, visit us

Follow us on our socials!

Paine Schwartz Partners (PSP) is a global sustainable food-chain investment private equity firm based in California and New York. The firm invests in middle-market companies across North America and Europe. PSP is exclusively focused on investing in food and agribusiness companies and brings a collaborative and active management approach to its portfolio companies.

Over the past 20+ years, PSP (together with certain predecessor and related entities) has invested $5.7 billion of equity capital across 87 food and agribusiness investments (including 31 platform transactions), representing over $10.0 billion of total transaction value. Currently, the fund\'s portfolio is comprised of 17 food and ag companies and a total of $6.5 billion in AUM. PSP recently held its final closing for Fund VI at $1.7 billion, which was above its original target of $1.5 billion and 17% bigger than its previous $1.4 billion Fund V.

Of any industry, we believe food and agribusiness presents perhaps the greatest opportunity to simultaneously create value and drive positive impact through responsible investment practices. PSP is committed to addressing imminent challenges facing the food and agriculture sector by championing companies that provide innovative solutions around food security, economic growth, human rights, positive environmental impacts and health products. With an intensive focus on Sustainability & ESG, we are a proud signatory to the Principles for Responsible Investment, the global leading proponent of incorporating ESG factors in investment decisions and processes. To this end, these investments are deeply aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), such as zero hunger, clean water and sanitation and climate action, among many others. For more information on Paine Schwartz Partners, please visit

Why Join Our Organization?

Joining our company means stepping into a role where you can truly enhance people\'s lives while unlocking your own potential. Here, your ideas aren\'t just heard but valued, giving you the freedom to shape your career and create a meaningful impact every day. Seize the opportunity to be part of something extraordinary, where your personal growth drives our collective success and makes a lasting difference in the lives we touch.

What Do We Expect?

The Monterey Nutra Division is a fast-growing B2B business unit supplying premium mushroom ingredients—such as powders and extracts—for use in functional beverages, supplements, gummies, and more. Monterey Nutra is a subsidiary of Monterey Mushrooms and Amycel. We are looking for a highly motivated, professional, and adaptable Marketing Specialist to join our team remotely from California and able to travel regularly.

This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, ever-changing, entrepreneurial environment. You will play a hands-on role in executing marketing initiatives across a wide range of activities—from content creation, brand storytelling, and digital campaigns to light graphic design and strategic planning. The ideal candidate is organized, articulate, and confident in customer-facing and internal meetings, capable of juggling both creative and tactical marketing responsibilities.

We welcome candidates who embrace modern tools and technologies, including the responsible use of AI, to streamline marketing tasks, boost creativity, and increase efficiency across projects.

What are we looking for?

  • Execute marketing strategies and campaigns that support our B2B ingredient sales across nutraceutical, food, and beverage markets
  • Create and edit compelling content for digital and print-product sell sheets, presentations, web content, email campaigns, social media, blogs, etc.
  • Manage project timelines and marketing deliverables, keeping stakeholders informed and aligned
  • Support branding and storytelling efforts across our channels and customer touchpoints
  • Make graphic edits and manage basic design projects using Adobe Creative Suite
  • Assist in the development and delivery of presentation decks for internal and customer meetings
  • Liaise with sales, R&D, and executive teams to ensure marketing aligns with product capabilities and customer needs
  • Coordinate and track marketing activities and results across CRM, analytics, and internal systems
  • Support conference and trade show participation-pre-event prep, materials development, lead follow-up
  • Draft press releases and coordinate approvals, ensuring messaging aligns with brand and product goals; respond to media inquiries and support participation in earned media opportunities by preparing talking points and background materials.
  • Maintain organized marketing asset libraries (logos, images, templates, etc.).
  • Ensure timely and accurate updates to websites, email platforms, and social media.
  • Represent the Nutra division professionally during virtual or in-person meetings with customers and partners.
  • Participate in competitive analysis, customer research, and industry trend monitoring.
  • Create or assist in capturing and editing basic video or photo content.
  • Provide marketing support to adjacent departments or sister companies as needed.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor\'s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field, preferably in Agriculture.
  • 3+ years of experience in a marketing role, preferably in B2B or ingredient/ food/ nutraceutical industries, or agricultural industries that relate such as fresh produce.
  • Strong writing, editing, and organizational skills.
  • Hands-on experience with social media, email marketing, and website updates.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides), Microsoft Office, and Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator), Canva.
  • Experience with HubSpot or a similar marketing automation and CRM platform is preferred, as this role will support lead generation, email marketing, contact management, social media and reporting efforts within our marketing system.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in food ingredients, supplements, beverages, or natural product sectors.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems and digital marketing platforms.
  • Light photography and video editing skills.
  • Passion for functional food and wellness categories.

Working with Agencies and Contractors

This role requires strong project management and communication skills to collaborate effectively with external marketing agencies, designers, freelance creatives, and other outside vendors. The Marketing Specialist will serve as a key point of contact, ensuring partners are aligned with brand guidelines, campaign objectives, and deadlines. From briefing creative teams to reviewing deliverables, this person will be responsible for driving projects forward, maintaining quality standards, and ensuring that all outsourced work supports the strategic goals of the Nutra division.

Travel, Trade Shows, and On-Site Content Capture

Weekly to monthly travel is required to support trade show participation and on-site marketing initiatives at our mushroom farms and production facilities. This includes coordinating and assisting with video and photo shoots, gathering behind-the-scenes content, and producing material for use in digital marketing, social media, and customer-facing platforms. The Marketing Specialist will be responsible for ensuring the content captured is consistent with brand storytelling and messaging while helping to document and showcase the people, processes, and products that set Monterey Mushrooms apart.

ENG (engbim.com) is a BIM company that specializes in hands-on, field-focused BIM services. The BIM Specialist role generally involves modeling different trades (MEP), depending on your background and the project scope, which may cover specific zones or entire buildings.   • A mechanical or civil engineering bachelor's degree (architects could be considered but only if they have extensive experience modeling and coordinating MEP trades themselves).

Specific requirements will vary depending on the position and service. Experience with Level Of Detail (LOD) 400 and projects based in the US, or constructability knowledge related to that country, will be a huge differential. Other desirable requirements are:

  • Familiarity with BIM add-ins (e.g., Evolve, SysQue, Fabrication Parts).
  • Experience in conceptual design / BIM Design assist.
  • AutoCAD Plant 3D knowledge.
  • Dynamo/Python knowledge applied to BIM.
  • On-site/field experience.

Um dos nossos 7 valores é o “Sawabona", seu significado é pra lá de especial, e praticado diariamente aqui na Zappts!
A saudação #Sawabona se originou no Sul da África, onde se acredita que todos nascemos pessoas boas, mas que, às vezes, podemos cometer alguns erros.
Segundo a cultura deste lugar, quando alguém comete erros, toda a população se junta e, durante dois dias, só falam sobre as coisas boas que aquela pessoa já fez. Ao final desse período, todo o povo cumprimenta seu conterrâneo com a expressão "Sawabona".
Esse, por sua vez, responde "#Shikoba" . Sendo assim, Sawabona significa: "Eu te vejo, eu te respeito, você é importante para mim" . E a resposta, Shikoba: "Então eu sou bom e existo para você" .
Aqui na Zappts, Sawabona traduz e representa o que mais prezamos em nossas relações: o respeito e a valorização do outro.
